entities.summary: Tijan Sallah (b. 1958-03-06, Serekunda) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Serekunda and Gambia. Known in the fields of gambia, merchants & economists, africa.
